dedupe_keys.name: french food outlet data assembly notebook

description: The French-Food-Outlets notebook assembles a nationwide food-outlet database from French administrative sources. The FEAST simulation library repository documents joins between SIRENE 3.11, Alim’ Confiance, organic-operator records and BODACC closure information. It uses Polars and a preliminary filter to reduce processing from approximately forty million entities to about five hundred thousand. The workflow can be repeated daily or in line with monthly SIRENE updates. A versioned Zenodo code archive declares CC BY 4.0 and is freely accessible. The article’s original MitchZweig repository returns 404; the dataset metadata links the working FEAST successor, whose root has no licence file. The licence assertion is confined to the archived release. Input endpoints and matching logic were not executed, so freshness and closure accuracy remain unverified. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing food-service points for spatial access and supply-disruption simulations. data-openstreetmap offers related transport-network context, but no automated connection is documented in the inspected README.
